# cron-pydantic

> Pydantic models for cron schedules, jobs, and crontab files

## Pages

- [cron-pydantic](index.html.md): Typed, YAML-friendly models for cron schedules, jobs, and crontab files.
- [Tutorial: build a crontab](docs/src/tutorial.html.md): In this tutorial, we will validate two cron jobs, render their crontab, and write it to a temporary file.
- [How-to guides](docs/src/how-to.html.md): These guides cover common crontab modeling and integration tasks.
- [Why modeling and installation are separate](docs/src/explanation.html.md): cron-pydantic treats a crontab as data: schedules and commands are validated, serialized, parsed, and written to an explicit path. It does not treat the curr...
- [API reference](docs/src/api.html.md): The public API is re-exported from cron_pydantic.
